[[Image:Solanum citrullifolium flower.jpg|thumb|left|Closeup of flower]]

'''''Solanum citrullifolium''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Solanaceae]] family.<ref name=KewPOWO>{{cite web|url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:818720-1|title= Solanum citrullifolium A.Braun|author=<!--Not stated-->|date=n.d.|website=Plants of the World Online|publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|access-date= September 25, 2020}}</ref> It is a [[Solanum|nightshade]] referred to by the common name '''watermelon nightshade''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=SOCI|taxon=Solanum citrullifolium|accessdate=17 November 2015}}</ref> as its leaves somewhat resemble those of a [[watermelon]] plant. It is a white-stemmed [[shrub]] with purple star-shaped flowers. It is native to the southern United States and it is grown in home gardens as an [[ornamental plant]].

Not to be confused with the similarly-named "melonleaf nightshade", which is a different species, ''[[Solanum heterodoxum|S. heterodoxum]]''.
